sentences: We caution investors that amounts presented in accordance with our definition of Adjusted EBITDA may not be comparable to similar measures disclosed by our competitors, because not all companies and analysts calculate Adjusted EBITDA in the same manner.

guidance.sentence: “Oscar delivered record profitability in the first half of the year and we are raising our full-year 2026 guidance,” said Mark Bertolini, CEO of Oscar Health.

summary: Oscar says it is raising its full-year 2026 guidance, but the excerpts give no specific guidance figures.
